title: Stitched Local Fiedler -- galactic-scale fault via spectral coarsening
gate_source: global Fiedler is O(N^3); sectioned local Fiedler must stitch continuously at boundaries

method.problem: independent local Fiedler vectors (arbitrary sign/scale/mode) -> disjoint spurious fault seams
method.coarse: Galerkin L_c = P^T L P, generalized eigenproblem (mass M_c=P^T P) -> global fault at section resolution
method.stitch: partition-of-unity Gaussian interpolation of coarse field over section centroids -> C^0 fault line
method.dynamic_halo: Gaussian width per section = kappa * spectral_diameter(1/sqrt(lambda_2^local)) * section_extent, clamped [1 leaf, section extent]
method.floor_rationale: 1-leaf floor guarantees the halo contains the delta_0 inter-section edges (EXP-501)

observables.spurious_seams: stitched fault edges on section boundaries not in global fault

assertions_fork_A: [2] Galerkin coarse: 100% section-sign agreement with global fault
[3] dynamic spectral-diameter halo with 1-leaf floor (halo widths reported)
[6] continuity: stitched fault-edge count == global (fault line reproduced)
[7] dynamic halo matches/beats fixed: seams(dynamic) <= seams(fixed sigma=0.3)
[10] decoupled: game/ has no engine.* import (clean-room guard)
assertions_fork_B: [2] sorted |stitched field| multiset fwd == mir (fault structure P_yz-invariant)

exp507_gate.target: resident-set memory bound; per-section local Fiedler on demand; content-addressed eviction
